approach: Read the starting position directly from x at t = 0, then differentiate x once and twice for velocity and acceleration.

steps.text: The particle's starting position is x at t = 0.
Differentiate x with respect to time to get the velocity, then substitute t = 0.
Differentiate v with respect to time to get the acceleration, then substitute t = 2 s.

common_mistakes.text: Reporting the velocity at t = 2 s, which is 28 m/s, instead of differentiating a second time for the acceleration, which is 26 m/s².
